context: Add CHANGED_PLANS and CHANGED_TUNING back-mapping blocks mirroring the existing manifest and applied handling, so a companion-only PR still validates its paired primary bundle, and cover it in the existing changed-bundles workflow test.
description: validate-submission.yml filters .plans.json and .tuning.json out of CHANGED, and sets has_bundles=false when no primary bundle changed. Unlike .manifest.json and .applied.json, which each have an explicit back-mapping block that re-adds the paired primary bundle, plans and tuning companions have none. A PR touching only those companions therefore skips bundle validation, public path scanning, companion hash validation, and corpus inventory validation. This matters because the privacy scanner explicitly targets those suffixes and commit ef0df3685 shows tuning files carry sensitive material. Reachability checked 2026-08-03: the corpus currently contains zero .plans.json and zero .tuning.json files, so the hole is latent and unexercised rather than actively exploited.

preserves.behavior: A PR touching no bundle or companion still short-circuits without running validation
